review_quotes.quote: Just last night (Saturday) I got Jim's number from a neighbor who recommended him. Jim responded within half an hour and this morning (Sunday) the technician was at my door before 9 AM.
review_quotes.author: David Cadaval

review_quotes.quote: Called Jim at around 7 pm and he answered and I told him my unit was frozen. He advised me what to do that night and was at my house first thing the next morning.
review_quotes.author: Chuck Hanna

review_quotes.quote: Jim and his team are absolutely the best! They are reliable, efficient and cost effective! Highly recommend them for all your AC needs.
review_quotes.author: Annette Strauch
